title: SHEESH
blurb: Length equals sincerity, and this is the rule that governs the entire sheesh economy. A clipped one is polite acknowledgement; a five-second SHEEEEESH, ideally with the vowel wobbling, means somebody has genuinely done something remarkable. It swept TikTok in 2021 alongside an accompanying gesture and became one of the defining slang sounds of the decade, mostly because it is impossible to say without committing to it. Play it for flexes, feats, absurd stat lines and outfits that go unreasonably hard. Overuse is a known hazard and nobody has ever cared.
